title_en: Cybercrime, Online Financial Fraud & UPI Scam: 1930 Helpline, Freeze & FIR
title_hi: साइबर अपराध, ऑनलाइन वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी और यूपीआई फ्रॉड: 1930 हेल्पलाइन, खाता फ्रीज और एफआईआर

laws.plain_meaning: Section 66 punishes computer related hacking/tampering; Section 66C punishes identity theft (fraudulent use of electronic signature, password, or unique identification feature) with imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to Rs. 1 lakh; Section 66D punishes cheating by personation by using computer resource.
Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property or alteration of valuable security is punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
Criminal breach of trust: dishonestly misappropriating or converting to one's own use property entrusted.

laws.act: Reserve Bank of India Circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18
laws.section: Customer Protection – Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions
laws.plain_meaning: Zero liability of customer where unauthorised transaction occurs through contributory fraud/negligence of bank, or third party breach where customer notifies bank within 3 working days.

steps.action_en: Immediately dial National Cybercrime Helpline 1930 (Golden Hour action) to report financial fraud. Provide bank name, account number, UPI reference ID, transaction date, and amount. The CFCFRMS system flags and freezes stolen funds across intermediary recipient wallets and accounts before cash withdrawal.
steps.action_hi: ठगी होते ही बिना देर किए तुरंत 1930 हेल्पलाइन पर कॉल करें (गोल्डन आवर)। बैंक, खाता नंबर, यूपीआई ट्रांजैक्शन आईडी और समय बताएं ताकि पैसा आगे ट्रांसफर होने से पहले फ्रीज किया जा सके।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Within 2 to 3 hours of fraud (Golden Hour maximizes money recovery)
documents_needed: Bank transaction SMS / UTR reference number

steps.action_en: Call your bank customer care to block debit card, internet banking, UPI credentials, and obtain an official dispute Acknowledgement / Ticket Number.
steps.action_hi: अपने बैंक को तुरंत सूचित कर खाता/कार्ड/नेट बैंकिंग ब्लॉक करवाएं और अनधिकृत लेन-देन का विवाद टिकट नंबर लें।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Within 3 working days under RBI guidelines for zero customer liability

steps.action_en: Register a detailed formal complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) under 'Report Financial Fraud' or 'Report Other Cyber Crime'. Download the official complaint PDF acknowledgement.
steps.action_hi: साइबर क्राइम पोर्टल (cybercrime.gov.in) पर जाकर पूरी घटना, स्क्रीनशॉट और बैंक स्टेटमेंट अपलोड कर पावती (Acknowledgement) डाउनलोड करें।
documents_needed: Bank account statement highlighting fraudulent debit
Screenshots of fake SMS, phishing website, or WhatsApp chat
Transaction UTR / IMPS / UPI reference numbers
Caller ID screenshot / suspected mobile numbers

steps.action_en: Submit the cybercrime portal acknowledgement slip and bank statement to the local Cyber Police Station or local police station to register a regular FIR under Section 66D IT Act and Section 318(4) BNS.
steps.action_hi: स्थानीय साइबर थाना या संबंधित थाने में जाकर पोर्टल रसीद जमा करें और धारा 66D IT Act तथा 318(4) BNS में एफआईआर दर्ज करवाएं।
steps.where: Cyber Crime Police Station / Local Police Station

steps.action_en: Once money is frozen by police in suspected accounts, file an application under Section 503 BNSS [old CrPC s.457] before the Judicial Magistrate for defreezing and release of money (supurdnama) back to your bank account.
steps.action_hi: फ्रीज हुए पैसे को वापस अपने खाते में पाने के लिए मजिस्ट्रेट की अदालत में धारा 503 BNSS (पुराना 457 CrPC) के तहत आवेदन दें।
steps.where: Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class having jurisdiction
steps.deadline_or_limitation: After police files status report confirming frozen amount
documents_needed: Police status report on seized/frozen funds

helplines.name: Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting Helpline
helplines.description: 24x7 dedicated national hotline for immediate freeze of defrauded electronic funds

helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
helplines.description: Ministry of Home Affairs official portal for lodging cyber complaints

helplines.name: RBI Banking Ombudsman
helplines.description: For resolving bank non-cooperation or unauthorized electronic transaction liability disputes

free_legal_aid.eligible: Citizens needing court intervention (such as filing Section 503 BNSS property release petitions or when bank refuses RBI circular adherence) are eligible for free DLSA counsel if under state income limit, or as women/senior citizens under s.12 LSAA.
free_legal_aid.how_to_apply: Approach District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in District Court complex or call 15100.

when_to_see_a_lawyer: To file a Section 503 BNSS application before the Magistrate for court order releasing frozen funds from intermediary bank accounts
If bank refuses to reimburse unauthorized transaction within RBI stipulated timelines
In cross-border hacking, sextortion, or corporate identity impersonation involving large amounts
